Click on the following links to see our Supply List: 2017-2018
Supply List [English] 

2017-2018
Supply List (Spanish Version)

Save the date:  August 31st 4:00 – 6:00 pm.  Everyone is welcome to bring in their supplies, meet their teachers and classmates before the school year kicks off.  Class List will be posted on the front doors of our school beginning Friday, August 25th at 4:00 pm.
